summary: Verified 2026-01 cosmetic polish + Live Cost Alert batch: (1) cookie consent banner suppressed on /admin/overview, /admin/qa, /admin/cockpit and still shows/dismisses correctly on public /; (2) admin-qa-skeleton renders on /admin/qa then admin-qa-dashboard mounts with real cards; (3) GET /api/aurem-dev/admin/insights/cost-alert requires admin JWT (401 without), returns full shape (period_days, ai_cost_total, revenue_total, aggregate_breach, paying_customers, offenders, offenders_count, email_enabled=false, recent_findings) and email_enabled defaults OFF in preview; (4) SLO endpoint still 200 (no regression); (5) cost_revenue_alert cron ON · every 1800s · email=False confirmed in backend log; (6) AdminOverview shows cost-alert-card + aggregate-tile + offenders-tile + slo-metrics-card side-by-side, no console errors. All 3 pytest cases pass; all Playwright checks pass.

cost-alert endpoint fetches recent_findings via db.cost_revenue_alert_log; ensure an index on created_at exists to avoid full collection scan as log grows.
